I would love to help you with your garden, but I find that growing *basil* is the most delightful way to enjoy fresh herbs at home. You should ensure your *basil* receives plenty of warm sunlight and is planted in rich, well-draining soil to encourage lush growth. Have you ever tried pinching off the top leaves of your *basil* to encourage it to grow bushier?
